scripts.dev:emulators: pnpm --filter @lex/functions build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-lex --import packages/functions/emulator-seed
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/check-docs.mjs && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && pnpm -r --sequential typecheck
scripts.validate: pnpm validate:m0 && pnpm validate:m1 && pnpm validate:m2 && pnpm validate:m3 && pnpm validate:m4
scripts.validate:m0: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm --filter lex-e2e test
scripts.validate:m3: pnpm validate:visual && pnpm validate:ux && pnpm --filter lex-e2e test:m3
scripts.validate:m4: pnpm --filter @lex/functions build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-lex --import packages/functions/emulator-seed "pnpm --filter @lex/app test:integration && pnpm --filter lex-e2e test:mp"
